about: one bead in repo-a unblocks one in repo-b across the repository boundary

beads.title: Add word_count(text) to textkit
beads.description:
FILED AGAINST: {sha}

Consumers need a word count. Add `word_count(text) -> int` to textkit/core.py: words are whitespace-separated tokens; empty text is 0.
beads.acceptance:
- `make gate` passes and tests/test_core.py includes a word_count test with an empty-string case
- `python3 -c "from textkit.core import word_count; print(word_count('a b  c'))"` prints 3
- README.md lists word_count under API

beads.title: Add --words to wc-report using textkit.word_count
beads.acceptance:
- vendor.json pins textkit to a repo-a commit that is on repo-a origin/main and contains word_count
- `python3 -m wcreport --words README.md` prints `<n> words` where n matches textkit.word_count
- `make gate` passes with a test for --words
